We wanted to share our heartfelt thanks to the team at Musters Medical Practice following an exceptional experience this November.

The practice looks after my elderly parents, who live alone, and as a family, we couldn't ask for better support. After my father became unwell one night, the process of seeking help in the morning was very smooth. The telephone call-back service was convenient, and the staff who took the details were patient and assuring. We were so relieved when they arranged for Dr Peachey to visit the house that same day.

Dr Peachey was, quite simply, amazing, wonderful. She has a natural ability to put patients at ease; she listened very carefully, understood the complexities of the situation, and explained the next steps with precision and clarity. She took the time to conduct a detailed review of my Father’s medication, identifying necessary changes and providing a revised plan that gave us huge reassurance. She arranged for a district nurse to attend to a wound as well. It felt like the perfect blend of high-level professionalism and that, "friendly neighbourhood doctor" feel.

A special mention must to the lovely Vanessa at the front desk. She was fantastic and handled my request for proxy online access very kindly and efficiently. Having access to their digital services has made staying connected to my parents’ healthcare so much more convenient.

It is rare to find a practice that balances modern digital efficiency with such genuine, old-fashioned care. Thank you to everyone involved.
